name: NOAA Storm Events Database
description: The NOAA Storm Events Database is the official United States record of severe and unusual weather occurrences, compiled by the National Weather Service (NWS) and archived by NOAA NCEI. Covering 1950 to the present, the database documents phenomena that cause loss of life, injuries, property and crop damage, or disruption to commerce, including tornadoes, hurricanes, flash floods, hail, thunderstorm winds, winter storms, extreme heat, and wildfires. Each event record includes event type, episode narratives, start/end timestamps, geographic coordinates, damage cost estimates, and casualty counts across all 50 states and territories.

publisher.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
